summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to send exactly one GET /v2/settlements with merchant_id, canonical tz (links and UTC offsets mapped to Etc/GMT zones), half-open from/to and a supported BCP 47 locale, with no deprecated parameters. Amounts are now computed locally with Decimal half-even rounding, currency digits and dashboard locale formatting. The meridale-v3-draft and 2025 display pages were not followed; the bundled test passes.
